What if a billion dollars was rice?
Rice sells for about 500 dollars a ton.
So a billion buys two million tons!
As cash? Just ten tons of bills.
As rice? Two hundred thousand times heavier!
Count one per second? Two and a half million years!
Load it up. Eighty thousand trucks!
Bumper to bumper? Over a thousand kilometers.
Pour it into your backyard pool?
You'd fill about a thousand Olympic pools!
A rice mountain thirty stories tall!
The whole world eats that in under two days.
Over half of humanity lives on rice.
So... would you take the cash or the rice?
